tableau.name: Dormand-Prince DOP853 propagating pair, 12 stages, order 8

convergence.description: Self-convergence on the N=50 backward Dyson system over T=0.08, max-abs errors vs a dt=6.25e-4 DP8 reference; observed order between successive dt halvings, for BOTH integrators on the same grid.

refinedRow.skipReason: At N>=1e5 the tightest-pair time t_pair << ladder dt, so the collision is resolved inside the first ladder step and the ladder bracket (0, dt] already contains t_pair; the dt/5 refinement adds no information at ~5x the O(N^2)-per-step cost and is intentionally not run.

pairBound.description: Tightest zero pair in the first N ordinates; isolated Calogero-Moser pair collapses at t_pair = H_min^2 / 8.

remainingGaps: GAP-2485-N1e6: a fresh dual-integrator row at N = 1e6 needs ~100x this runtime (O(N^2) per stage, ~22 s per derivative eval already at N = 1e5) and consumes the entire bundled 1e6 Odlyzko table with no headroom; the native compute backend (skp-imp423-compute) is required.
